meta_description: Prior-authorization on governed agents — 61% of requests auto-adjudicated within policy and clinician review time down 57%

blocks.x: Prior-authorization on governed agents — 61% of requests auto-adjudicated within policy and clinician review time down 57%

a PBM whose prior-authorization desk had become the industry's favorite complaint: clinicians waited days for decisions their patients' pharmacists needed in hours. Figures are the client's own, shared with permission.

The baseline fortnight measured the desk: median 2.9 days per decision, 84% of requests eventually approved as submitted, and clinician reviewers reading records for requests the policy had already answered.
The policy existed; applying it was manual. Each request triggered chart-reading that took longer than the clinical question deserved, and the backlog reset every Monday.

We moved prior-auth onto governed agents: requests parsed against the signed policy criteria, chart evidence retrieved and cited per criterion, and the decision path split — policy-satisfied requests auto-adjudicated with the full evidence trail, everything else queued for clinicians with the reading already done. The appeals loop learns back into the criteria library.
